title: UIIC Administrative Officer AO Recruitment 2026 Online Form
vacancyDetails: Administrative Officer (Generalists): 200 posts; Administrative Officer (Hindi Officers): 25 posts
qualification: Bachelor / Master degree in any discipline with minimum 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD) for Generalists; Master degree in Hindi/English with the required subject combination for Hindi Officers
ageLimit: 21 to 30 years as on 30/06/2026; age relaxation as per UIIC recruitment rules
applicationFee: General / OBC / EWS: ₹1,000 + GST; SC / ST / PH: ₹250 + GST
selectionProcess: Tier I exam → Tier II exam → Interview / further selection stage as notified by UIIC
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, thumb impression, ID proof, address details, educational certificates, category certificate, disability certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://uiic.co.in/web/recruitment/details/1620
2. Read the full notification and confirm your eligibility
3. Complete the online application form with personal and academic details
4. Upload documents, photograph, signature and thumb impression
5. Pay the application fee through the official payment mode
6. Preview the form and submit it
7. Save and print the final acknowledgement
shortDescription: UIIC Administrative Officer AO Recruitment 2026 notification has been issued for 225 posts. Candidates can apply online from 08 September 2026 to 28 September 2026, subject to the official notification and eligibility conditions.
content: UIIC has invited applications for Administrative Officer (Generalists) and Administrative Officer (Hindi Officers) posts. A total of 225 vacancies are available, and the online application window runs from 08/09/2026 to 28/09/2026. Eligible candidates should review the official notice carefully because the Tier I exam is scheduled for 22/10/2026 and the Tier II main exam is on 30/11/2026.
editorNotes: Job entry created from the official UIIC recruitment notice for Administrative Officer posts. The official portal should be checked for updates and final eligibility conditions.
importantInstructions: Apply only through the official UIIC recruitment portal. Keep the acknowledgement slip and payment receipt. The official notification is final for fees, age rules, eligibility and exam schedule.

faqs.question: What is the total number of UIIC AO vacancies for 2026?
faqs.answer: UIIC has notified 225 Administrative Officer vacancies in total, including 200 posts for Administrative Officer (Generalists) and 25 posts for Administrative Officer (Hindi Officers).

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 28/09/2026. The fee payment deadline is also 28/09/2026.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for UIIC AO 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 30 years as on 30/06/2026. Age relaxation is available as per UIIC recruitment rules.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for UIIC AO 2026?
faqs.answer: General / OBC / EWS candidates pay ₹1,000 + GST, while SC / ST / PH candidates pay ₹250 + GST.
